experiment: Paper1_UIE V6 training-only fidelity eligibility analysis
candidate_source: frozen V4 best checkpoint; same deterministic preprocessing as V5 train-only calibration

metric_definitions.reference_fidelity: per-candidate mean absolute error to paired reference, same F.l1_loss reduction none then mean C,H,W used by Paper1LossV5
metric_definitions.consequence_error: ConsequenceCheckModule consequence_error, per-image mean absolute reconstruction error

frozen_threshold.interpretation: A candidate is eligible only when its reference L1 is no more than 5% above the best candidate for that training image. This is a directly interpretable upper bound on relative fidelity sacrifice; chosen before V6 implementation/training and before validation inspection. It was not selected to obtain a candidate share.

preservation_consequence_rank_calibratio.rank: mean of each eligible raw component standardized by its training median and IQR
